title: Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 for Weyl algebras: Lean 4 formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization, verified against Mathlib, of Stafford's Conjecture 3.8: for every field k of characteristic zero, every n, and every nonzero d in the Weyl algebra A_n(k), there exist F, R, S with 1 = d R + F d S. The development also proves the exact Bernstein-degree fixed-source strengthening, the general tangent-limit, asymptotic-conormal and coisotropic-exclusion theorems of the accompanying manuscript, and the localization, adjoint and evolutionary corollaries. Every endpoint depends only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The repository contains the Palomar Challenge/Solution pair, the Comparator configuration, the verification scripts and the machine-readable verification record.
notes: Kernel-checked Lean proof. Independent human expert review of the mathematics and the accompanying manuscript are separate; see docs/verification.md for the exact scope of the machine check.
